respuesta.pregunta: I'm trying to run payment-promise-gateway locally from IntelliJ. What environment variable do I need to set, and what VM options should go in the run configuration?
respuesta.respuesta:
Both documented versions, 0.0.10-test-crc-migration and latest, give the same instructions for running the project locally.

- **Environment variable:** set `SCOPE=dev` or `SCOPE=local`. The docs say you need one of these to run the project locally [payment-promise-gateway/0.0.10-test-crc-migration/guide/README.md:L494-L494] [payment-promise-gateway/latest/guide/README.md:L494-L494].
- **Where to add the VM options:** in IntelliJ, right-click `Main.java`, then go to Modify Run Configuration... / Modify options / Add VM options, and fill in the VM OPTIONS field [payment-promise-gateway/0.0.10-test-crc-migration/guide/README.md:L495-L495] [payment-promise-gateway/latest/guide/README.md:L495-L495].
- **VM options to use:** `-DconfigFileName=src/test/resources/application.properties -DchecksumEnabled=false -Djava.rmi.server.hostname=localhost` [payment-promise-gateway/0.0.10-test-crc-migration/guide/README.md:L497-L497] [payment-promise-gateway/latest/guide/README.md:L497-L497].
